lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Interactive visualization unlocks real-time user control over GPT-2's outputs, making it a dynamic tool for exploration and discovery.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Static visualizations capture the full complexity of GPT-2’s neural architecture, revealing patterns and hierarchies that interaction might obscure.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Interactive tools like TensorBoard allow users to drill into layers, track loss curves, and adjust hyperparameters on the fly—this is practical AI development.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Visualization through 3D embeddings and attention maps provides a holistic view of model behavior that no UI can replicate in real time.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Visualization isn’t just about looking—it’s about understanding the model’s inner workings at scale.
